title: Identification and validation of tolerogenic dendritic cells-related biomarkers in diabetic retinopathy.
authors: Wei, Chun-Yi; Li, Song-Man; Liu, Ling-Juan; Huang, Jun-Peng; Lai, Xiao-Hui; Yang, Li-Juan; Liang, Wen-Wang
one_liner_zh: 该文通过机器学习筛选糖尿病视网膜病变中耐受性树突状细胞相关生物标志物，虽涉及转录因子TFEC但仅做表达与免疫浸润分析，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Diabetic retinopathy (DR) is a primary microvascular complication of diabetes. Its pathogenesis is associated with chronic inflammation and immune responses. While tolerogenic dendritic cells (tolDCs) are critical for suppressing excessive inflammation and maintaining immune homeostasis, their function in DR is not well characterized. OBJECTIVE: To identify biomarkers associated with tolDCs in DR and to explore their mechanisms. METHODS: Biomarkers were identified from public databases using differential analysis, machine learning (LASSO regression analysis and Random Forest analysis), and expression validation. Their mechanisms were then explored through enrichment analysis and immune infiltration, and ultimately validated by reverse transcription-quantitative PCR (RT-qPCR) on clinical blood samples. RESULTS: A total of 2096 differentially expressed genes (DEGs)1 were identified between DR and control groups. By intersecting with 6267 tolDCs-related genes, 51 key candidates were selected. Machine learning and expression validation further pinpointed two biomarkers: transcription factor EC (TFEC) and chromatin modifying protein 2 A (CHMP2A). Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA) showed significant enrichment of TFEC in 994 pathways and CHMP2A in 748, with co-enriched pathways including apoptosis, VEGFA-VEGFR2 signaling, and VEGF signaling. Analysis identified eight altered immune cell types; TFEC correlated strongest with activated NK cells (cor = - 0.49, p < 0.001), while CHMP2A correlated with resting mast cells (cor = 0.49, p < 0.001). RT-qPCR confirmed TFEC upregulation and CHMP2A downregulation in DR, validating the bioinformatic results. CONCLUSION: TFEC and CHMP2A are potential biomarkers involved in DR pathogenesis via tolDCs.
abstract_zh: 背景：糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）是糖尿病的主要微血管并发症，其发病机制与慢性炎症和免疫反应相关。尽管耐受性树突状细胞（tolDCs）在抑制过度炎症和维持免疫稳态中至关重要，但其在DR中的功能尚未得到充分表征。目的：识别与DR中tolDCs相关的生物标志物，并探讨其机制。方法：通过差异分析、机器学习（LASSO回归分析和随机森林分析）及表达验证，从公共数据库中识别生物标志物。随后通过富集分析和免疫浸润探讨其机制，并最终通过临床血液样本的反转录定量PCR（RT-qPCR）进行验证。结果：在DR组和对照组之间共识别出2096个差异表达基因（DEGs）。与6267个tolDCs相关基因取交集后，筛选出51个关键候选基因。机器学习和表达验证进一步确定了两个生物标志物：转录因子EC（TFEC）和染色质修饰蛋白2A（CHMP2A）。基因集富集分析（GSEA）显示，TFEC在994条通路中显著富集，CHMP2A在748条通路中显著富集，共同富集的通路包括凋亡、VEGFA-VEGFR2信号传导和VEGF信号传导。分析识别出八种改变的免疫细胞类型；TFEC与活化NK细胞的相关性最强（cor = -0.49，p < 0.001），而CHMP2A与静息肥大细胞相关（cor = 0.49，p < 0.001）。RT-qPCR证实DR中TFEC上调、CHMP2A下调，验证了生物信息学结果。结论：TFEC和CHMP2A是通过tolDCs参与DR发病机制的潜在生物标志物。
